fact: On 30 September 2026 the BCEAO published the list of participants authorised to open PI-SPI instant interoperable payment services to the public, with 19 in Mali including Moov Money, Sama Money and Orange Finances Mobiles Mali alongside banks.
title: OUVERTURE DES SERVICES DE PI-SPI AU PUBLIC : la BCEAO autorise 175 participants dont 19 banques et institutions financières Maliennes
